title: Wanting to record excerpts of Chick Webb arrangements
summary: Jones says he must record Chick Webb's arrangements such as "Harlem Carnival" and "Spanish Town" as a last crowning work.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yes, I must. Now they asked me to do recordings. You know I quit recording, but if I could ever do excerpts - excerpts - of Chick Webb. Now I must do the Harlem Carnivals, I must do the 'Spanish Towns.' I must do it with small groups and what have you; and then the big band and what have you, little 'Liza' and what have you. I must do this.

I must do this and some way, some how, Milt, I'm going to do it. That's the last crowning glory because I have somebody in California say, 'You want to do it. I have a little studio, I have a little money, whatever you're but the people say I have to have to play with me. asking...' I don't care if I never record no more, I must do this. I said, 'You people have done Rodgers and Hart, you've did this, you've did that - why can't I do Excerpts of Chick Webb?' I said, 'You people going with Tommy Dorsey and the Benny Goodman story and what have you. Why can't I do Mr. Chick Webb?'
